name: schedule/WeekSchedule
description: Week schedule: true on the selected weekdays within a time-of-day range (local time)

inports.name: range
inports.description: Time of day "HH:MM-HH:MM", e.g. "07:00-18:00": start included, end excluded; "00:00-24:00" is all day

inports.name: days
inports.description: Weekdays, a selector such as "1-5" or "6,7": 1-7, day 1 Monday (or Sunday if sunday_first)

outports.name: out
outports.description: True on the selected days within the range
